in the suite guards 2945's intent and nothing will go red to remind anyone. The
body states this under its own warning heading and links
restore-the-dettid-alignment-without-spawning-a-host-thread, which was already
OPEN in the graph before this revert created the obligation.

The body also states the trade in the words it was decided in: a known,
measured, spine-node blocker for a named and tracked identity mismatch, not for
silence.

PROBE LESSON CARRIED OUT OF THIS TASK. A bisect probe must key on the PRODUCT
CONDITION, never on the wording the tree happens to use. The same condition --
the kvm cell produced no comparison -- appears as
  FAIL  ... Signaled { signal: 14 } ... no comparison was returned
  ERROR ... verification recorded no comparison at all (verdict=no_result)
and mapping ERROR to untestable gave 43 untestable against 4 bad and 1 good,
degenerating. Keying on "did the kvm cell produce a passing comparison" gave 7
probes, zero untestable, clean convergence. Treat only an explicit PASS as good,
map every non-pass verdict to bad, and reserve the skip code for a failed build
or a missing verdict line. Recorded in durable agent memory as
a-bisect-probe-must-key-on-the-condition-not-the-label so it is not relearned.

WHAT REMAINS ON THIS TASK. Once 3096 lands, e2e.manifest_c_programs should clear
its deterministic blocker. Two things outlive it:
  - netlink-autobind-generic (verify/sabre), INTERMITTENT at 2 of 6 runs, still
    unexplained and still inside e2e.manifest_c_programs.
  - the backend-parity expectation question (99 cells, kvm and liteinst), which
    is with the owner and is explicitly NOT this lane's to wait on.
So this task does not close on 3096 alone.
